INSERT INTO activity_log (actor_id, verb, entity_type, entity_id, entity_name)
SELECT $1, 'noted', $2, $3,
  CASE
    WHEN $2 = 'contact' THEN (SELECT TRIM(CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name)) FROM contacts WHERE id = $3)
    WHEN $2 = 'opportunity' THEN (SELECT name FROM opportunities WHERE id = $3)
    WHEN $2 = 'task' THEN (SELECT subject FROM activities WHERE id = $3)
    WHEN $2 = 'company' THEN (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = $3)
    ELSE NULL
  END;

parameters.query:
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN $2 = 'task' THEN COALESCE(a.contact_id, oa.contact_id) WHEN $2 = 'opportunity' THEN oo.contact_id END AS contact_id,
    CASE WHEN $2 = 'task' THEN COALESCE(a.account_id, ac.account_id, oa.account_id) WHEN $2 = 'opportunity' THEN oo.account_id END AS account_id,
    CASE WHEN $2 = 'task' THEN a.subject WHEN $2 = 'opportunity' THEN oo.name END AS label,
    CASE WHEN $2 = 'task' THEN 'task' WHEN $2 = 'opportunity' THEN 'deal' END AS kind
  FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
  LEFT JOIN activities a ON $2 = 'task' AND a.id = $3
  LEFT JOIN opportunities oa ON oa.id = a.opportunity_id
  LEFT JOIN contacts ac ON ac.id = COALESCE(a.contact_id, oa.contact_id)
  LEFT JOIN opportunities oo ON $2 = 'opportunity' AND oo.id = $3
)
INSERT INTO entity_activity_log (entity_type, entity_id, category, subtype, summary, detail, actor_id, actor_name)
SELECT 'contact', r.contact_id, 'system_audit', 'noted', COALESCE((SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1), 'Someone') || ' added a note to the linked ' || r.kind || ' "' || r.label || '"', jsonb_build_object('link_type', r.kind, 'link_id', $3), $1, (SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1)
FROM resolved r WHERE r.contact_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'company', r.account_id, 'system_audit', 'noted', COALESCE((SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1), 'Someone') || ' added a note to the linked ' || r.kind || ' "' || r.label || '"', jsonb_build_object('link_type', r.kind, 'link_id', $3), $1, (SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1)
FROM resolved r WHERE r.account_id IS NOT NULL;
